title: WhalesIslandReef D18 future import descriptor
description: Static, machine-verifiable future-Runtime import description for a D18 logic asset record (D18-L25). It declares expected units, axes, bounds, material slots, skeleton type, animation list, root-motion, collision intent, LOD intent, license dependency and fallback. This is NOT Unity Import Settings: it contains no importer options (no mesh/material/animation importer values, no compression, no per-platform overrides) and it never states that an asset was imported, is playable, is runtime-ready or is approved. represents_imported_asset is fixed to false. The descriptor imports nothing, modifies nothing and grants nothing; actual import happens only in a future Runtime phase gate.

repo_relative_path.description: Repository-relative path only. Absolute paths, drive letters (C:), UNC names (\\server), backslashes, leading slashes, whitespace and '..' traversal segments are forbidden.

positive_meters.description: Length in meters; must be a positive finite number.

descriptor_kind.description: Fixed discriminator; distinguishes this schema from manifests, catalogs and result JSON.

source_asset_id.description: Reference to the D18-L02 logic asset record canonical_asset_id (asset_<...>). Never a disk path or display name; the referenced record is the sole source of provenance/license/state facts.

type.description: Logical asset category; must equal the D18-L02 record category (L45 cross-checks). Character, ship, environment, UI and audio have different descriptor shapes enforced by the allOf conditions below.

units.description: Expected linear units of the source asset. meters is the target convention; unknown must be resolved before Runtime import.

axes.description: Expected coordinate conventions of the source asset. Target convention for the game is Y-up / Z-forward; any other declared convention must be handled by a Runtime import transform, never by silent assumption.

oneOf.description: Expected axis-aligned bounding box in meters (width = x, depth = z, height = y). Declared expectation only; real bounds are measured by L26 mesh-descriptor validation, never invented here.

material_slots.description: Expected material slots of the source asset (slot name + role). Empty for assets without materials (audio, pure data). Slot roles follow the frozen taxonomy (body/outfit for characters, wood/metal for ships and props, ground/leaf for environment, ui for interface materials).

material_asset_id.description: Optional reference to a D18-L02 material record backing this slot.

skeleton_type.description: Expected skeleton/rig type of the source asset. humanoid implies Humanoid Avatar intent for characters; none/static apply to environment, ships, props, UI and audio; animal/fish apply to the ecology taxonomy. This is a declared intent for a future Runtime import, not an Avatar or Animator creation.

animation_list.description: Expected animation clips of the source asset, as design keys only. Roles follow the character animation categories (idle/walk/run/work/combat/...), ship sailing (sail), ecology (swim/fly) and interaction (interact). No clip is imported; real clip extraction belongs to a future Runtime phase.

root_motion.description: Optional per-clip expectation of root-motion baked into the clip.
Declared root-motion handling intent: none (no root motion expected), required (clip-driven locomotion), derived (compute/derive at import), unknown (must be resolved before Runtime import).

collision_intent.description: Declared collision intent for the future Runtime consumer: capsule_agent for characters/animals, convex_mesh/simple_box for ships and props, terrain for environment, none for UI/audio. This declares intent only; it creates no collider and grants no runtime right.

oneOf.description: Declared LOD intent for geometric assets: number of levels (1-5) and whether LODs are expected to be generated automatically at Runtime import. null for non-geometric assets (UI/audio/material).

license_dependency.description: License the future import depends on. Must mirror the referenced D18-L02 record license; unknown/conflicting/NC licenses never grant import rights.

fallback.description: Declared fallback if the asset cannot be imported at Runtime: reference must be the placeholder content id or an asset record id, description explains the degradation (e.g. keep placeholder, keep candidate-only, reject). A missing or empty fallback is invalid: every import attempt needs an honest rollback statement.

represents_imported_asset.description: Fixed false. This schema must never claim an asset was imported. Any true value is invalid by construction.

allOf.description: Non-geometric types (audio, ui, material, lighting_reference) carry no geometry, skeleton, collision, LOD, bounds or animation.
Geometric types must declare expected bounds; a null bounds is invalid for them.
Character descriptors require a character skeleton intent.
Ecology descriptors require the matching ecology skeleton intent.
Static geometry (ship, environment, prop, building) is declared as none/static skeleton intent.
